items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Mr. Walker, when we recorded this tune... I did another tune for him.

ctx.x: Um, wait, wait, wait, I'm, I'm, the discography over here just kind of ends right there at Rick. And so I've got some other labels here that I, I didn't recognize that I, that I brought. Okay. And I don't want you to tell me what, like what years that was in. Okay. Uh, the Dewdrop label.

This was Mr. Walker. Now, Mr. Walker, the man that recorded King Floyd. Oh, okay. Okay. And, um, this, this kind of interesting with this. And in fact, I don't know if you know, I re, I re-recorded this to him. I re-did it. But I did not, I didn't re-record it.
And which song is that on there?
